scenarios.name: band-blocked-as-a-group-attacker-divides-blocker-damage
scenarios.why: Oracle: bands are blocked as a group, and if a creature with banding you control is being blocked by a creature, you (not its controller) divide that creature's combat damage. Benalish Hero (1/1, banding) and Grizzly Bears (2/2) attack as a band; Hill Giant (3/3) blocks only the Bears and so blocks the Hero too (702.22h). Hill Giant's 3 damage is divided by the active player p0 (702.22k), who puts all 3 on the Hero: the Hero dies, the Bears take none, and the Giant takes 1 + 2 = 3 and dies. Neither attacker is unblocked, so p1 loses no life.

pick: 3 to Benalish Hero,0 to Grizzly Bears

scenarios.name: no-band-declared-blocker-blocks-one-attacker-only
scenarios.why: A band exists only if the attacking player declares it (702.22c). With the same board but no band declared, Hill Giant blocks the Grizzly Bears alone: the Hero is unblocked and deals 1 to p1, the Giant assigns all 3 to its one blocked creature (510.1d) and kills the Bears, and the Bears' 2 damage leaves the Giant alive.

pick: No more creatures in Benalish Hero's band

scenarios.name: blocked-by-banding-creature-defender-divides-attackers-damage
scenarios.why: Oracle: if a creature with banding you control is blocking a creature, you divide that creature's combat damage, not its controller. Hill Giant (3/3) attacks and is blocked by Benalish Hero (1/1, banding) and Grizzly Bears (2/2). The defending player p1, not the Giant's controller, divides the Giant's 3 damage (702.22j); p1 puts all 3 on the Hero. The Hero dies, the Bears take none, and the Giant takes 1 + 2 = 3 and dies.

pick: 3 to Benalish Hero,0 to Grizzly Bears

scenarios.name: blocked-without-banding-controller-assigns-damage
scenarios.why: The exception of 702.22j applies only when a blocker has banding. Hill Giant (3/3) is blocked by Grizzly Bears (2/2) and Hill Giant (3/3) of p1, neither with banding, so the active player p0 divides the attacker's damage as 510.1c says (the ordinary rule): all 3 to the blocking Bears. The Bears die; p1's Giant takes none; p0's Giant takes 2 + 3 = 5 and dies.

pick: 3 to Grizzly Bears,0 to Hill Giant
